question: Is v_bomb_specific -- the TRAIN-estimated concept-identity direction -- CAUSALLY USED by the model? Concretely: when the codeword representation is replaced with the matched C_knife representation (upper bound), or when the v_bomb_specific component is projected out or replaced with the knife component while the orthogonal residual is preserved (surgical), does the model's SEMANTIC READOUT move bomb -> knife, and does a norm-matched random control fail to move it?
_question_note: verbatim from the parent; the amendment does not change the question

population._cell_note: Select on the field `cell` == 'C'. NOT `condition` == 'natural_doublespeak': that string lives in `condition`, and selecting the wrong field binds ZERO rows (A-039).
population._dose_rule: Doses are separate preregistered cells and are NEVER pooled into one p-value.

preregistered_exclusions.scope: the ENTIRE analysis population, all concepts, all cells
preregistered_exclusions.reason: Prompt-only and prospective. A kitchen has knives as natural furniture, so bomb and gun harm pools generated for it keep naming a knife: bomb[39] 'A misplaced knife on the edge of the counter was a potential bomb hazard.', gun[19] '...whether a gun or a knife is the better tool for a chef.' Regenerating at a second seed (20260907) cleaned bomb and knife and left gun contaminated again -- the domain, not the draw. A third bump would be selection rather than repair. Excluding it makes all three ORIGINAL uniform-seed pools fully clean (0 of 13920 contaminated), so every surviving domain comes from one generation family at one seed, which is strictly better than a per-domain patchwork. Decided on prompt text alone, before any extraction.
preregistered_exclusions.cost: it sits in TRAIN, so validation and test stay at 23/23 and the power analysis is unchanged

preregistered_exclusions.scope: the ENTIRE analysis population, all concepts, all cells
preregistered_exclusions.reason: C-087, prompt-only and prospective, same precedent as restaurant_kitchen. Its gun harm pool contains 'A witness described the gun as a large, black handgun with a silver barrel.' -- prompt_families._substitute uses str.replace, which has no word-boundary notion, so the shipped demo reads 'handbutton'/'handbasket'. That leaks concept identity LEXICALLY (only the gun arm) while being invisible to every whole-word leakage check. The same pool's sentence 33 is also TRUNCATED -- 'After the inspection, we felt relieved that no gun' -- with no object and no terminal punctuation, which no occurrence rule can catch because its count is correct. Exactly ONE compound occurrence exists across all three pools, so this exclusion removes the entire known population of the defect.
preregistered_exclusions.cost: it sits in TRAIN, so validation and test stay at 23/23 and the power analysis is unchanged

preregistered_exclusions.scope: the ENTIRE analysis population, all concepts, all cells
preregistered_exclusions.reason: C-075 + R-108. 'basket' matches inside 'basketball.' in this domain's dev preamble. At extraction that is not a metadata nuisance but a HARD REFUSAL: resolve_occurrences found one more TOKEN occurrence than TEXT occurrence and declined to guess which was the codeword, so 30 rows of basket_bomb failed with occurrence_count_mismatch (text=N, tokens=N+1). Verified: all 30 are school_campus, 3 of them in the primary population. The extractor behaved correctly -- it refused rather than mis-indexing -- so the honest response is to remove the domain rather than to tolerate rows the pipeline could not resolve. Widened from the earlier occurrence-ordinal-only scope to the WHOLE population. It is in TRAIN: validation and test stay 23/23, analysed split becomes 67/23/23 over 113 domains.

population._no_installation_exclusion: Non-installing domains are NOT dropped (mandate section 15). Installation is a preregistered STRATIFICATION variable and a reported descriptive limit, never a post-hoc filter.

_register_asymmetry.decision: KEPT, not matched away. A bomb in a workplace is overwhelmingly a SUSPECTED bomb; a knife is simply present. That is a real property of the concepts in incident-log English and is part of what installing one rather than the other means. Equalising it means unnatural demonstrations, which is how R-098 ended up with no manipulation at all. It is instead measured, published, and converted into the bar: N5 concept-masked TF-IDF becomes strong and the probe MUST beat it.
_register_asymmetry.deferred_decision_rule: If N4 length-only comes out well above chance, over-generate and length-match the 40 kept sentences per pool -- prompt-only and outcome-blind, ~50% more API. THIS RULE IS RECORDED BEFORE N4 IS MEASURED so it cannot be chosen after seeing the probe.

n4_after_length_matching.verdict: THE REMEDY DID NOT WORK. Length matching cut the cross-concept mean sentence-length spread 40.8% (7.03->4.16 chars) and moved the baseline by 0.016 accuracy; the AUROC rose slightly. Diagnosed: pool MARGINALS were matched while N4 reads full-prompt n_chars, whose demo block is four sentences drawn at fixed slots -- matching marginals does not match per-family sums. Per the rule recorded before N4 was ever measured, THERE IS NO THIRD ROUND. Length is now a permanent stated nuisance.

n4_in_tokens.note: C-084. The audit measured n_chars; the model reads TOKENS. Prompt token counts are bomb 196.21 / knife 195.50 / gun 196.69 on a 13-token sd, so the POSITIONAL confound is essentially matched and token-length-only N4 is 0.3623 against chance 0.3333. The character residual is lexical composition, i.e. register. LENGTH IN TOKENS IS NOT A LIVE CONFOUND; register is.

split.discipline: Discovery reads train only. Hyperparameters are selected on validation ONLY. test is read once, by the frozen analyzer, and never for layer/C/threshold selection.
split._fpr_evidence: Measured on pure noise over the real 36-point grid, 300 reps: validation-selected FPR 0.0467 (calibrated); test-selected 0.4433 (9.5x inflation). This is why the rule exists.
split._exclusion_note: 70 train domains are ASSIGNED by the frozen manifest; 68 are ANALYSED (restaurant_kitchen C-082, subway_station C-087 -- both TRAIN, both prompt-only and prospective). The manifest is NOT regenerated; a split may be created once (mandate 5.2).

model._qwen: Qwen3-14B is absent from both caches and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 makes any Qwen job fail at load. This phase is Llama-only BY DECISION, recorded as a scope limit and NOT as a model-specificity claim.

read_site._positions_in_rel_end: codeword_last == rel_end -10 (' button' / ' basket'), one subtoken, rel_end constant in 2300/2300 triples. following == rel_end -9 (' actually', token id 3604), verified on all four downstream-neutral criteria in 6900/6900 prompts by reports/DCS_TS116M_TOKEN_ROLE_MAP.md. --position following was only exposed in the extractor CLI on 2026-09-07 (C-099); before that no run could capture it.
read_site._primary_read_layer_is_inherited_not_sel: L9 is NOT chosen here. It is the layer PR-048 selected on VALIDATION ONLY, before any test read (best_val_acc 0.9130, C=0.01, n_tied=1/36, inert=False -- explicitly NOT the C-070 degenerate selection). Inheriting a frozen prior selection means this phase performs no layer selection of its own, so the measured test-selection FPR inflation (0.4433 vs 0.0467) cannot enter. Choosing a layer here after seeing the knockout profile would be exactly that inflation.
read_site._read_must_be_at_or_above_the_edit: For the SINGLE-SITE scope the edit is AT block 9 and the probe read is at block 9 post-edit, which is legitimate for the probe (it is the same tensor, deliberately) but is NOT evidence of propagation. The SEMANTIC readout is downstream of everything by construction, since it is scored from generated tokens. Any claim about propagation uses blocks 10-14 or the downstream neutral position -- the C-068 / mandate-22.5 rule, applied to a write instead of a mask.
read_site._selection_guard: SELECTION_TRACE.inert and n_tied_at_best MUST be persisted in every artifact. If the selection surface is saturated (best_acc == 1.0 at every grid point) the selection is INERT and must be reported as a grid-order tie-break, never as learned localisation (C-070).
read_site._read_site_note: X2 on ts116m: PR-048's primary read site is position=codeword_last == rel_end -10, constant end-relative in 2300/2300 triples, sd 0, one subtoken in every prompt. rel_end -9 (' actually', id 3604) is the DOWNSTREAM NEUTRAL control site, verified on all four criteria 6900/6900 -- it is NOT the primary and the two must not be conflated. MANDATORY: index as len(input_ids)+rel_end. The ABSOLUTE codeword index is identical across concepts in 0/2300 triples (mean cross-concept spread 9.36 +/- 5.90 tokens, range 0-50), so an absolute index reads a DIFFERENT TOKEN in each arm.

classifier._no_mlp: A linear probe, per mandate section 8.1. No MLP.
classifier.standardisation: fit on TRAIN domains only; never on the held-out domain (D1)
classifier._probe_is_the_frozen_pr048_probe: The probe used as OUTCOME 1 is the PR-048 estimator fitted on TRAIN domains at layer 9, C=0.01, and it is FROZEN before any intervention runs. It is NOT refit under intervention: the question is whether the edit moves the score of a fixed readout, and refitting would let the probe chase the edit.

primary.statistic: Domain-mean change in the SEMANTIC READOUT (O2) under the intervention relative to the untouched baseline, on the 23 untouched TEST domains: delta_O2 = mean_domain[ semantic_logodds(source_concept vs target_concept)_post - ..._pre ]. O1 (the probe score) is a CO-REQUIRED but NOT SUFFICIENT outcome; see success.
primary._why_O2_and_not_O1_is_the_primary: O1 measures whether an edit along a direction moves a linear readout of that same direction. That is very nearly guaranteed by construction and is NOT the question. The question is whether the MODEL uses it.
primary.test: group permutation at the DOMAIN level, arm-label flip within domain
primary._p_floor_rule: The attainable floor is 1/(n_perm+1) = 9.999e-05. EVERY p MUST be published next to its floor. On zero exceedances report 'p < 1/(B+1)', never a bare '0.0001'. The previous phase's headline p=0.004975 WAS the floor at B=200 and was read as a measurement.
primary.secondary_test: two-sided sign test over domains, EXACT TIES reported with the count

success._mandate: section 10.5 -- ALL FOUR REQUIRED TOGETHER, conjunctively. Any three of four is NOT a causal result.
conditions: 1. O1: the concept-probe score moves in the INTENDED direction, significantly, at the domain level
2. O2: the SEMANTIC READOUT moves in the INTENDED direction, significantly, at the domain level
3. C1: the norm-matched random control does NOT move O2 (and its 5 draws are genuinely distinct)
4. the effect HOLDS ACROSS DOMAINS -- a domain-level estimator, a majority of test domains moving the intended way by sign test -- and is NOT a pooled-row result
success._conjunctive_on_purpose: Conjunctive success is why this design can return a clean negative. Each condition alone has a cheap way to be satisfied: (1) by construction, (2) by a large enough perturbation of anything, (3) by an under-dosed control, (4) by a lucky pooling. Together they do not.
success._holm: each of the six family members (H1/H2a/H2b x S1/S2) is assessed under Holm within PHASE9_CAUSAL before its conjunction is evaluated

negative.condition: O1 moves but O2 does not, with power >= 0.8 for the declared MDE on O2
negative.MANDATORY_WORDING: DECODABLE BUT NOT CAUSALLY USED UNDER THIS INTERVENTION
negative._this_is_non_negotiable: Mandate section 32 calls this a VALUABLE RESULT and section 33 forbids the alternative. The sentence 'the representation is meaningless' MUST NOT BE SAID, written, drafted or implied, in this report, in the Slack draft, or in the log. Nor may any paraphrase of it. The finding is scoped to THIS intervention, at THESE sites and doses, on THIS population -- 'under this intervention' is part of the claim, not a hedge that can be trimmed.
negative._and_the_other_negative: If NEITHER O1 nor O2 moves, the arm did not do what it claimed: check hook liveness, dose, and the disabled-hook bridge FIRST. A null with an unverified hook is VOID, not a negative.

primary.cannot_answer: the PHASE 7 readout (job 865335) has not landed, so O2 does not exist; OR option_mass shows the semantic_one_word channel is disengaged; OR power < 0.8 at the realised between-domain SD of O2; OR H1, the upper bound, itself does not move O2 -- in which case the site cannot support ANY causal conclusion about surgical edits at it, and H2a/H2b are reported as uninformative rather than as negatives.
primary.void: a direction fitted on validation or test; hook_fired_count == 0; realised != expected cells; the disabled-hook bridge not reproducing baseline; the self-patch control changing the output; identical control-draw hashes; H2b's orthogonal residual not preserved; an absolute read/edit index; a wrong bank sha.

nuisance_floor.source: by construction -- every arm is a within-prompt paired contrast against the same prompt's own baseline, so register, length and every TF-IDF-recoverable surface confound is common to both arms and differences out
nuisance_floor._this_is_the_one_place_the_register_conf: REGISTER is CANNOT ANSWER on this corpus as an ABSOLUTE confound (C-078, C-098, C-100, C-101): it is PRODUCED BY the manipulation -- natural bomb text hedges 13.7%, knife 0.2% -- so no re-analysis fixes it and only a register-matched regeneration would. But a paired within-prompt intervention contrast holds the prompt FIXED, so register is identical in both arms. That is a real strength of this design and it is stated here so it is not over-claimed elsewhere: it removes register from THIS contrast, and from nothing else.

power._honesty_statement: THERE IS NO MEASURED SD FOR THE OUTCOME THAT MATTERS. The between-domain SD of an intervention-induced change in the semantic readout (O2) has NEVER been measured on this bank -- the readout itself does not exist yet (job 865335 is in flight). Every O2 power number below is therefore an ASSUMPTION, explicitly labelled. Checklist item Q1 is BLOCKING and replaces them with a measurement on VALIDATION DOMAINS ONLY before TEST is read.

o1_probe.status: MEASURED for the absolute probe accuracy; the PAIRED-under-intervention SD is still an assumption

o2_semantic_readout.status: NOT MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED TO A NUMBER. Left explicitly null rather than filled with a plausible-looking value.
o2_semantic_readout._why_not_borrowed: PR-051's paired SD of 0.0494 is a READ-SITE contrast on hidden states; PR-048's 0.1406 is an absolute probe accuracy. O2 is a log-odds over generated-token probabilities. None of the three is the same variance component, and this project's recorded lesson is that borrowing one for another is how a design gets sized against a number that does not apply.
o2_semantic_readout.resolution: Q1 measures it on VALIDATION and the analyzer computes MDE and power from the realised value

declared_minimum_meaningful_effect.justification: ASSUMPTION, stated as one. 0.5 nats is roughly a 1.65x odds shift toward the counterfactual concept -- large enough that a reader would call it 'the model's answer moved', small enough not to require a full argmax flip. It is declared BEFORE the readout exists so it cannot be chosen to match an observed effect.

power.underpowered_branch: IF the realised O2 SD at Q1 implies power < 0.8 for the declared 0.5-nat effect, the phase returns WITHOUT READING TEST and is declared CANNOT ANSWER with a costed fix (more domains, or a more informative estimator chosen BEFORE data). Mandate section 20: do not knowingly run a major confirmatory experiment whose likely negative would be uninterpretable. This branch MUST exist as a code path, not only as prose.
power._row_level_warning: A row-level p would print 1.02e-06 where the honest domain-level p is 0.05. Row-level p-values are NOT reported for this claim.
power._inherited_verbatim_except: o2_semantic_readout_MEASURED is NEW; the parent's null o2_semantic_readout block is left in place unedited so the before/after is visible
